# 2 Baruch Chapter 47 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Dialogue

---

**47:1** And-I-Baruch sat-down there, and-I-mourned over-Babylon and-over what-had-happened to-the-people, and-I-wept because-of-the-many-captives who-had-been-taken from-Zion.

**47:2** And-I-cried-out with-a-loud voice, saying: "O-LORD, you-who-endure-forever, whose-fire-consumed Zion, give-ear now to-the-prayer-of your-servant."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
